description: This Java class 'ExecHelper' provides utilities for running and managing an external simulator process, including starting the process, dumping output streams, and destroying the process.

classes.name: ExecHelper
classes.description: A utility class to run and manage an external simulator process, handle its output, and control its lifecycle.

methods.name: runSimulator
methods.description: Internal method that starts the simulator process, logs its size, output, and termination, intended for internal use.

methods.name: dumpProcessOutput
methods.description: Reads the output of the provided process, logs output lines, and echoes error stream.

methods.name: readAndPrint
methods.description: Reads lines from a BufferedReader and applies a consumer action to each line.

methods.name: createErrorStreamEcho
methods.description: Creates a Runnable that reads from the error stream of a process and logs each line.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Stops the running simulator process if it exists.

methods.name: startSimulator
methods.description: Starts the simulator in a new thread.
